summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by IM Cannabis Corp., a foreign private issuer, attaching a press release about the filing of a resale registration statement on Form F-3 with the SEC. The registration covers 17,276,931 common shares issuable upon conversion of convertible promissory notes and exercise of warrants issued in April, May, and June 2026. The company receives no proceeds; only selling shareholders may resell. This is a routine shelf registration for resale, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or similar event. Watch for SEC effectiveness, but no risk-arb angle.
